introHtml: Cnij badges combine durability with a professional finish, making them a practical choice for employee identification, safety credentials, and access control. Unlike standard paper badges, these hold up to daily wear and can be customized with your logo, barcode, or magnetic stripe. Perfect for manufacturing floors, corporate offices, or events requiring secure, reusable credentials.
